name: 06071 · Somers, CT
findings: ZIP 06071 (Somers) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (62%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 10 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 06071 (Somers) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
31% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 06071 (Somers) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 10 organizations here; 48% of all organizations here have no identified type.
